header.title: Trackly
header.subtitle: Smart Finance Management Platform
header.description: A multi-platform financial product for tracking expenses, managing budgets, monitoring bills, and gaining smarter insights.

trackly.coverAlt: Trackly smart finance management platform mockups

details.body: Managing personal finances can quickly become complicated when expenses, bills, debts, budgets, and reminders are spread across different tools. Users often struggle to maintain a clear overview of their financial activity and make informed decisions about their spending. The goal was to create a unified platform that makes financial management simpler, more organized, and easier to understand. We focused on a clean and intuitive experience across web, dashboard, and mobile, combining visual financial insights, expense tracking, budget management, reminders, and smart AI-supported features to help users stay informed, reduce financial stress, and maintain better control over their money.

gallery.alt04: Trackly product overview with feature highlights

header.title: Sprout
header.subtitle: Community Garden Management Mobile App
header.description: A mobile platform for organizing gardens, volunteers, plots, and harvest activities.

sprout.coverAlt: Sprout community garden management mobile app mockups

details.body: Managing community gardens can become difficult when information is scattered across manual records and separate files. Teams often struggle to coordinate volunteers, monitor garden plots, track planting schedules, and record harvest activities efficiently. The goal of this project was to design a simple and user-friendly mobile application that brings all of these tasks into one centralized system. By focusing on clarity, accessibility, and structured information flow, the experience helps administrators, garden managers, and volunteers work more smoothly together. The result is a clean digital solution that supports better coordination, accurate record-keeping, and a more organized community gardening experience.

header.title: Educational Dashboard
header.subtitle: School Management Web App
header.description: A responsive dashboard concept for managing students, attendance, assignments, grades, and academic activity.

eduDashboard.coverAlt: Educational Dashboard school management web app mockups

details.body: Managing daily academic activities can become complicated when student data, attendance, assignments, grades, and communication are spread across different tools. The goal was to create a centralized dashboard that simplifies these tasks while giving teachers and administrators a clear view of student performance and classroom activity. We focused on a clean, structured interface that prioritizes usability and quick access to important information. By combining simple navigation, organized data visualization, responsive layouts, and both light and dark modes, we created an intuitive experience that supports smoother academic management across desktop and mobile.

gallery.alt02: Educational Dashboard project details and feature overview

header.title: MyWFP
header.subtitle: Self-Registration Mobile App
header.description: A mobile experience designed to simplify beneficiary registration, profile updates, and access to assistance services.

details.body: MyWFP is a mobile self-registration experience designed for WFP beneficiaries. The project focuses on simplifying registration and profile updates while making the process clearer, safer, and easier to complete. The experience uses step-by-step registration, secure identity verification, real-time validation, auto-save, and offline support to reduce errors and prevent data loss during unstable connectivity. It also provides a clearer way to manage family information, update personal details, and review information before submission. The goal was to create a simple and accessible mobile experience that supports both new and existing beneficiaries while maintaining clarity, security, and ease of use.

perspective.title: 01 - PERSPECTIVE
perspective.quote: "Good interfaces begin with understanding the system behind them."
perspective.para1: My background in software engineering fundamentally shapes how I design. I don't just look at the visual layer; I deconstruct the underlying architecture. This allows me to create interfaces that are not only aesthetically pleasing but structurally sound and highly feasible for development teams to implement.
perspective.para2: I believe that true simplicity on the front-end is achieved by rigorous analysis on the back-end. By mastering system flows and requirements early on, I ensure that the user's path remains clear, logical, and undisturbed by technical complexities.
